text:
ryan: Seeing intermittent 503s from eu-west1 embeddings starting ~22:05 UTC. I have a tiny restartless hotfix branch that guards KV eviction. Requesting expedited 22:15-22:30 UTC window.
deploy-bot: /deploy request created repo=rl-inference ref=hotfix/kv-guard-small env=eu-west1 strategy=restartless-canary id=DBOT-10277

lia: Ops needs the runbook + explicit gates. Share rollback steps.
sre-oncall: Risk low. Operational note: initial micro-canary preferred to avoid cache stampede. Rollback: traffic pin to v1.2.2 + run kv-clear job. Trigger if errors > 3% sustained 5m OR p99 > 900ms.
cass: Proposal: micro canary 0.1% for 10m -> 2% for 10m -> 100% if stable. That reduces blast radius.
release-manager: Draft changelog entry ready. Will push after confirm.
ryan: Runbook + dashboards: https://runbooks/kv-guard and https://dash/embeddings?env=eu-west1. Rollback snippet: `kubectl run kvclear --image=ops/kvclear:stable --env=eu-west1`.

lia: Runbook validated. PD hooks set. Ops approved if SRE oncall monitors.
sre-oncall: Ill watch p99 and error-rate; on breach Ill post "rollback intent" and trigger pin.

platform-ops: Ready to pin traffic and run the clear job on command.
deploy-bot: T-minus 5m to scheduled start. Any objections?
ryan: none, kick it.
deploy-bot: STARTED DBOT-10277 rolling 0.1% canary. status: https://deploys/dbot/10277/status
deploy-bot: CANARY CHECK (10m): errors 0.2% baseline 0.15%, p99 +60ms. Within gates.
sre-oncall: traces clean. safe to promote to 2%.
deploy-bot: PROMOTED to 2%  observing 10m.
cass: metrics steady, no customer reports.
sre-oncall: p99 stable; errors ~0.5%. Clear to finish after timer.
deploy-bot: ROLLOUT COMPLETE: v1.2.3-hotfix at 100% in eu-west1. Audit: https://deploys/dbot/10277/audit

release-manager: Changelog published and support notified. Tag: v1.2.3-hotfix.
ryan: Thanks all, closing thread.

lia: Good coordination, nice low-risk approach. :tada:
